''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

In Finnish, the Wheel of Time translates as ''Ajan Pyörä''. Each original English book has been split into two or three (prequel being exception) Finnish editions, published by Karisto. The first seven Finnish volumes were translated by Marja Sinkkonen; the subsequent volumes as well as the prequel were translated by Susanna Paarma.<ref>[http://fi.risingshadow.net/index.php?option=com_library&Itemid=67&action=series&series_id=17 fi.risingshadow.net]</ref>
